description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.

The role

AI in healthcare advances safely if people can trust it. Right now, it’s being deployed faster than anyone can check how well it actually works. We’re solving that problem by building out our Assessments team, which runs independent evaluations on real patient records. Those records go beyond text and includes scans, pathology slides, and audio. We’re looking for the Founding Platform Engineer to join that team.

Working with our researchers and customers, you’ll make sure the environments that the evaluations run in are secure and auditable. If you’re the type to obsess over tracking how a model behaves in an evaluation environment, and proving it did the work the way it should, you’re the right fit.

What you'll do

  • Design and build isolated eval sandboxes. Models should only run and be scoped to what the eval requires them to do.

  • Build the inference layer. Any customer model, hosted weights or API, runs through one standard path and is scoped to be independent.

  • Stand up each new customer’s AI model. Their model runs securely against our held-out data, and with less custom work each time.

  • Make every eval run auditable. Each run leaves a record of what the model did.

  • Red-team our sandbox. You find areas where a model can leave leftover credentials, can shortcut an assessment, or move outside of the sandbox.

  • Make the evals look real. Working with our researchers, you’ll remove cues that tell a model it’s being evaluated.

What success looks like

  • 30 days: Learned how our assessments runs end to end, met our researchers and first customers, shipped first improvements to our inference layer and a first customer evaluation run.

  • 60 days: Owning the sandbox and inference layer end to end for every active customer, ensuring that every run is auditable.

  • 90 days: A new customer goes from model handoff to first scored run in 2 days and a new health system is onboarded with our platform in 14 days.

What you'll bring

  • You’ve built and run isolated environments for models.

  • You’ve designed network, identity, and secrets boundaries in one of the major cloud providers, and one that has held up through an incident or security review.

  • You’ve turned a one-off customer deployment into something a teammate could repeat.

  • You’ve run GPU workloads in production.

  • Nice to have: you’ve built or broken an eval harness, RL environment or sandbox.

  • Nice to have: you’ve worked with healthcare data

  • Nice to have: you’ve run inference on data that doesn’t fit in an API model’s context window, like large images, long audio, or video.
